terms.comment: Our bedtime sea game: the child stands on the duvet while Dad holds a corner or side and moves it to make waves; the child jumps, falls and tumbles. The title is our own. The game’s imagery and example sentences are composed for the child.

phrases.latin: Tū nauta es; hoc est mare.
phrases.english: You’re the sailor; this is the sea.

sources: Our family game and its name; the grouped card gave no source.
The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
